allow_content_0: This will open a list of devices next to the URL bar. Select your device in the list and click Connect.
allow_info_0: Is your device not showing up?
allow_title: Allow the browser to connect to your device
can_not_delete_unused_profile: Cannot delete a configuration that is in use
circle_execute_macro: Loop through a macro a specific number of times
clear_local_data_confirm: Do you want to clear local data?
connect_device_permission_required: Allow browsers to link to your device
dialog_distance_desc_0: Set the trigger stroke of each single button
dialog_distance_desc_1: Drag the slider on the left to adjust the trigger travel of the selected key
dialog_distance_desc_2: Click the left button or hold down the left button and slide to select multiple buttons at once
dialog_distance_desc_3: Right-click or hold the right button and slide to deselect multiple buttons at once
dialog_keytype_desc_1: Select the button you want to replace, and then select the type of axis to replace.
dialog_keytype_desc_2: Click the left button or hold it down and slide it to select multiple buttons at once.
dialog_keytype_desc_3: Right-click or hold the right button and slide to deselect multiple buttons at once.
dialog_rt_desc_0: Set quick trigger for each button individually
dialog_rt_desc_1: A selected button will enable quick triggering. An unselected button will not be enabled.
dialog_rt_desc_2: When not enabled, the key's trigger and reset travel will be fixed to the set travel.
dialog_rt_desc_3: Press and drag to select multiple keys. Use the buttons below to select or deselect all keys.
DKS_label_desc: A single button can realize 4 functions, and you can bind functions according to different pressing degrees
empty_macro_name: Macro definition name cannot be empty
END_label_desc: A single key can send another key function when released
get_device_failed_retry: Failed to obtain the device, please reconnect
guider_device_add: Click here to add a new device
guider_device_refresh: You can refresh the authorized devices here🚀
guider_keyboard_key: Use the left mouse button to drag to the corresponding position on the keyboard
guider_leftmenu_add: Click here to add a new configuration
guider_leftmenu_profile: Left click to select configuration, right click to rename
guider_macro_start_record: Click here to start recording macro
kb_performance_desc_0: You can customize your own trigger travel points
kb_performance_desc_1: Adjust the RT trigger and reset travel to your own liking
kb_performance_desc_2: Sensitivity: Sensitivity determines the distance it takes for a key to be released (reset) and pressed again (trigger).
kb_performance_desc_3: It is not recommended to set the value less than 0.04mm, as it may be judged as a key release due to slight finger shaking.
kb_performance_desc_4: Independently set RT trigger sensitivity and lift sensitivity
kb_performance_desc_5: If enabled, you can customize the sensitivity of the Quick Trigger's press (trigger) and lift (reset) independently
kb_performance_desc_6: The top dead zone is to reduce false touches, and the bottom dead zone is to reduce disconnection.
kb_performance_desc_7: When the dead zone is 0, a slight shake of the finger may be considered as a key release. Please set it with caution.
least_left_key: Keep at least one left button
light_mode_txwh: Walking on the snow without leaving any trace
light_mode_ycjf: On the verge of breaking out
line_correct_desc: The mouse will make straight line corrections when moving
macro_length_limit: Sorry, the maximum length of macro definition is 150 units.
macro_name_empty: Macro definition name cannot be empty
MPT_label_desc: A single button can trigger three different button functions at three different depths
MT_label_desc: A single button can realize 2 functions, pressing and clicking can trigger different functions
name: name
press_other_stop: Terminate when another key is pressed
press_running_up_stop: Execute when pressed, stop when released
report_settings_desc: The mouse reports its current status to the computer every unit time(Hz)
reset_dpi_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to reset DPI settings?
reset_factory_confirm: Do you want to factory reset your device?
reset_keys_confirm_desc: Reset current layer button to default settings?
ripple_control_desc: The mouse moves at high speed and performs algorithm correction to reduce jitter
select_bar_desc_0: First select any key to bind the advanced key. You can use up to 40 advanced keys per profile.
select_bar_desc_1: A key position can be bound to at most one advanced key function
select_dks_desc_2: One button for 4 functions: You can bind 1 to 4 functions according to 4 different pressing degrees
select_dks_desc_4: Click the key on your keyboard to bind here
select_dks_desc_7: Lift when the key bottoms out
select_dks_desc_9: Set the trigger point for DKS action
select_end_desc_2: A single key can send another keystroke when it is released
select_end_desc_4: Click the key on your keyboard to bind here
select_end_desc_5: When the bound key is released, the bound key value will be triggered
select_end_desc_6: You can click or drag the key value you want to bind from the menu bar on the right to here
select_mpt_desc_2: A single button can trigger three different button functions at three different depths
select_mpt_desc_4: Click the key on your keyboard to bind here
select_mt_desc_2: A single button can perform two functions: one is to hold the button down, the other is to click the button
select_mt_desc_4: Click the key on your keyboard to bind here
select_mt_desc_5: Manually adjust the hold time (default is 200ms)
select_mt_desc_6: If "hold" is bound to a modifier key in combination with another key, the hold will be triggered immediately unless the other key is also a double-click key.
select_socd_desc_2: SOCD will bind the 2 selected keys and activate them according to the settings you choose
select_socd_desc_4: Click the key on your keyboard to bind here
select_socd_desc_6: Select two keys to trigger when you select a condition
select_socd_desc_8: The last activated key will overwrite the previous keys.
select_socd_desc_10: Key 1 always takes precedence over Key 2
select_socd_desc_12: Key 2 always takes precedence over Key 1
select_socd_desc_14: When both buttons are activated, neither will be triggered
select_tgl_desc_2: Click the button to switch continuous triggering on or off, and hold the button for normal triggering behavior
select_tgl_desc_4: Click the key on your keyboard to bind here
select_tgl_desc_5: Manually adjust the hold time (default is 200ms)
select_tgl_desc_6: Since it takes time to determine whether it is a single click, the triggering of a single click button will be slower than a normal button. Enabling fast triggering for this button and reducing the reset distance will improve it, but it is still not as good as a normal button.
SOCD_label_desc: Bind two buttons. The button pressed later will force the previous button to be released. Only one button will be triggered at the same time.
surface_tuning_desc: Use algorithms to correct jitter caused by surface damage
TGL_label_desc: Click the button to switch on or off continuous triggering, and hold the button for normal triggering
welcome_content_0: Here you can quickly configure your device, try out some unique settings, and personalize it to your liking.
welcome_content_1: After the configuration is completed, there is no need to leave it in the background. You only need to save, close and enjoy.
welcome_content_2: Supports Chrome and Edge browsers. More devices are being adapted...🚀🚀🚀

rhythm_no_param_tips: This type has no configurable parameters
rhythm_is_persist_label: After closing the page, you want the rhythm to be:

installed_but_connection_failed: Installed but connection failed, please check the port number of HEROMusicServe.exe
if_initialization_still_fails: If initialization still fails after following the instructions, please contact technical support.
device_initialization_failed_try_to_rein: Device initialization failed, try to reinitialize.
music_rhythm_mode_is_running: The music rhythm mode is running, please stop or turn off the rhythm mode first
calibrate_tips: Tips: Press any button, wait for the device to release for about 1 second after the bottoming out, and the calibration will be more accurate.

rhythm_running_tips_2: The current edge lighting is pulsing to the music. After turning off music rhythm mode, it will automatically switch to normal lighting mode after 3 seconds.
replace_switch_desc: Note: Please turn off the power before replacing the shaft!
key_type_magnetic_switch_heaven_king_nor: The King of Heaven's Normal Axes
